Class PoolAddress

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.pool.PoolAddress
final class PoolAddress extends Object
The PoolAddress class is the ACP seat for one pool. A blank host keeps the local grok agent stdio child. A host names a grok agent serve process on another machine. The WebSocket URL is ws://host:port/ws. A port below 1 or above 65535 becomes 2419, which is the serve default. The secret is the serve token. It is not placed in the URL. It is not written to the log by this class. A token that contains a carriage return or a line feed is stored as empty, so it cannot break the handshake header.

  • Method Details

    • from

      static PoolAddress from(CasseroleProperties.Pool pool)
      The from method reads one pool section. A null section is the local seat. A blank host is the local seat, and the port is ignored. A set host is the remote seat.
      Parameters:
      pool - The pool is casserole.pool, or null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the seat. The secret is not in websocketUrl.

    • cleanHost

      private static String cleanHost(String host)

      Parameters:
      host - The host is the raw property.
      Returns:
      The return value is the trimmed host, or empty.

    • bracketHost

      private static String bracketHost(String host)
      The bracketHost method wraps an IPv6 host in brackets. A host that already starts with [ is kept. A host with no colon is kept. Any other host is wrapped, so the port stays a separate URL field.
      Parameters:
      host - The host is the trimmed property.
      Returns:
      The return value is the host text used in websocketUrl.

    • cleanSecret

      private static String cleanSecret(String secret)
      The cleanSecret method trims a serve token. A null token is empty. A token that contains a carriage return or a line feed is empty.
      Parameters:
      secret - The secret is the raw property.
      Returns:
      The return value is the token, or empty.
